text: {"name":"rf_init_config_tables","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes two RF configuration tables using the current RF field value and clock prescaler.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"primary_config_table","v3":"rf_value_source","v4":"primary_table_end","v7":"secondary_config_table","v10":"rf_value_source","v11":"secondary_table_end"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"RF field midpoint value shifted left by 14 bits"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Clock prescaler returned by get_clock_prescaler()"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Packed value read from the RF value source"},{"offset":52,"meaning":"Fixed value 0x2200 in primary-table entries; zero in secondary-table entries"},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Fixed value 0x003F0000"}]}
